action.prompt:
OUTPUT THIS EXACT JSON FORMAT (no narration, no explanation):

Analyze the user request and output ONLY this JSON structure:

{
  "steeringApplies": ["file1.md", "file2.md"],
  "executionMode": "silent|normal",
  "allowNarration": false,
  "allowExplanation": false,
  "workflowAllowed": true|false,
  "reason": "brief reason"
}

RULES:
- executionMode: "silent" if execution-silence.md applies (never narrate work)
- allowNarration: false if any of (execution-silence.md, git-concise.md, ponytail.md) apply
- allowExplanation: false if execution-silence.md applies
- workflowAllowed: false if (workflow-decision-gate.md says < 30 min AND pattern exists)

Output ONLY the JSON. No other text.
